LanguageData.AyameICCT_PlasticGranule.label: food-grade plastic granules
LanguageData.AyameICCT_PlasticGranule.description: Type 5 polypropylene granules, manufactured to Interstellar Cha Chaan Teng's Food Safety Enterprise Standard for Food-Contact Plastic Materials and Articles. The restaurant chain recently published this standard to regulate its colonists' food businesses on the rim. Some local industrial factions also use it as a guideline. Resourceful colonists can produce these granules themselves once they master basic organic synthesis. The granules come in small sealed bags made from the same plastic.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_PlasticSheet.label: food-grade plastic sheet
LanguageData.AyameICCT_PlasticSheet.description: A sheet of polypropylene plastic. It looks a lot like cling film, even though that is a different kind of plastic. On the rim, there is only so much room for such distinctions. Manufactured to Interstellar Cha Chaan Teng's QB 4806.7-5498 standard, which every plastic meal container purchased from the chain is supposed to meet... hopefully.
